subject: Graduate Engineer Civil application, Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.company_line: Graduate civil role on land development projects covering roads, drainage, earthworks and stormwater on the Sunshine Coast
letter.subject: Application: Graduate Engineer, Civil (Sunshine Coast)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Graduate Engineer, Civil role with Colliers Engineering and Design on the Sunshine Coast, listed on SmartRecruiters. The advert covers land development design support across roads, drainage, earthworks, stormwater and civil documentation.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language, with road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi in the Philippines (2014 to 2019).

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge engineer at JustBuilt and as field engineer at Grand Travaux, including inspections, crew coordination, materials tracking and progress reports. My AutoCAD and Civil 3D experience to date is academic rather than commercial production drafting, and I have not used Civil 12D.

I live in Melton Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for regional work and open to discussing relocation to the Sunshine Coast.
I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

checklist: Create or sign in to SmartRecruiters with macdarenz@gmail.com
Upload resume PDF and cover letter PDF
Confirm work rights as Subclass 485 to December 2027
